note: Mutants of the desktop game's window icon (src/ants_app/app_icon.cpp, the call in application.cpp; docs/INSTALL_AS_APP.md, 'The desktop game's icon') for tools/mutate.py (docs/WORKFLOW.md, 'Mutation checks'). Run from the checkout: python3 tools/mutate.py tests/data/desktop_icon_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1. Both are caught by test_app_icon, which reads the surface back through SDL and asks the application whether it gave its window the icon.
